simple: Threat intelligence: indicator-of-compromise feeds (malicious IP addresses, domains and files) from 100+ sources, indicator scoring and search, profiles of threat groups and ransomware mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, reports by industry and region, dark web news. Tracks vulnerabilities — which ones are already being exploited and how dangerous they are, automatically analyzes suspicious files, provides ready-made SIGMA/YARA detection rules for SIEM and EDR, search in public repositories and cloud storage, and basic tracking of incidents at suppliers. Unlimited access to 20,000+ SIGMA/YARA rules, instant indicator enrichment, an API and integrations (indicator feeds, investigations, vulnerabilities, threat groups), user roles, audit log and SSO.
